#include "app_debug.h"
#include "board.h"
#include "command.h"
#include "epd.h"
#include "st25dv.h"
#include <string.h>

#ifndef APP_DEFAULT_STAGE
#define APP_DEFAULT_STAGE 3u
#endif
#ifndef APP_BUSY_ACTIVE_LOW
#define APP_BUSY_ACTIVE_LOW 1u
#endif
volatile app_debug_t g_debug={
    .magic=0x45504431u, .stage=APP_DEFAULT_STAGE, .busy_active_low=APP_BUSY_ACTIVE_LOW
};
static uint8_t uid[8];
static uint32_t last_refresh_end;
static bool have_refreshed;

void HardFault_Handler(void)
{
    g_debug.fault=1u;
    GPIOA->BSRR=2u;
    for (;;) { __NOP(); }
}
static int read_uid(void)
{
    uint8_t b[8];
    int r=st25_read_uid(b);
    g_debug.nfc_error=r;
    g_debug.nfc_present=r==0;
    if (!r) {
        static const char hex[]="0123456789ABCDEF";
        memcpy(uid,b,8u);
        for (unsigned i=0;i<8u;++i) {
            g_debug.uid_lsb_first[i]=b[i];
            g_debug.uid_hex[2u*i]=hex[b[7u-i]>>4];
            g_debug.uid_hex[2u*i+1u]=hex[b[7u-i]&15u];
        }
        g_debug.uid_hex[16]=0;
    }
    return r;
}
static uint8_t execute(uint32_t opcode)
{
    if (opcode<1u || opcode>6u) { return 2u; }
    if (opcode==3u && (g_debug.stage<2u || read_uid())) { return 3u; }
    /* Keep accepted commands pending until the panel has rested for 5 s. */
    if (have_refreshed) {
        uint32_t elapsed=(uint32_t)(board_millis()-last_refresh_end);
        if (elapsed<5000u) { board_delay_ms(5000u-elapsed); }
    }
    board_led(2u,true);
    g_debug.epd_error=epd_show(opcode,uid,g_debug.busy_active_low);
    last_refresh_end=board_millis(); have_refreshed=true;
    board_led(2u,g_debug.epd_error!=0);
    if (!g_debug.epd_error) { ++g_debug.refresh_count; }
    return g_debug.epd_error ? 4u:0u;
}
static void run_boot_sequence(void)
{
    g_debug.boot_phase=1u;
    g_debug.last_opcode=1u;
    g_debug.last_status=execute(1u);
    g_debug.boot_colors_done_ms=board_millis();
    if (g_debug.last_status) { g_debug.boot_phase=5u; return; }
    g_debug.boot_phase=2u;
    board_delay_ms(5000u);
    if (g_debug.stage>=2u && g_debug.stage<=3u) {
        g_debug.boot_phase=3u;
        g_debug.boot_uid_start_ms=board_millis();
        g_debug.last_opcode=3u;
        g_debug.last_status=execute(3u);
        if (g_debug.last_status) { g_debug.boot_phase=5u; return; }
    }
    g_debug.boot_phase=4u;
}
int main(void)
{
     g_debug.reset_flags=board_take_reset_flags();
    board_init();
    command_tracker_t tracker={0};
    uint32_t prev_stage=g_debug.stage, heartbeat_at=0u, uid_at=0u, poll_at=0u;
    uint8_t ack_seq=0u,ack_status=0u;
    bool ack_pending=false;
    unsigned ack_attempts=0u;
    uint32_t ack_at=0u;
    /* Baseline old EEPROM BEFORE the long boot animation so a new phone
     * command written during boot is still eligible afterwards. */
    if (g_debug.stage==3u) {
        uint8_t a[4],b[4];
        int r=st25_read_command(a);
        if (!r) { board_delay_ms(10u); r=st25_read_command(b); }
        if (!r && memcmp(a,b,4u)==0) { (void)command_accept(&tracker,b); }
        g_debug.protocol_armed=tracker.baselined;
    }
    run_boot_sequence();
    for (;;) {
        uint32_t now=board_millis(),stage=g_debug.stage;
        g_debug.uptime_ms=now;
        g_debug.busy_pin=pin_read(GPIOA,EPD_BUSY);
        g_debug.gpo_pin=pin_read(GPIOB,NFC_GPO);
        if ((uint32_t)(now-heartbeat_at)>=500u) {
            heartbeat_at=now; ++g_debug.heartbeat;
            board_led(1u,(g_debug.heartbeat&1u)!=0u);
        }
        if (stage!=prev_stage) {
            tracker=(command_tracker_t){0};
            g_debug.protocol_armed=0u; ack_pending=false;
            uid_at=now-2000u; poll_at=now-250u; prev_stage=stage;
            if (stage<2u) { g_debug.nfc_present=0u; }
        }
        if (stage>=2u && stage<=3u && (uint32_t)(now-uid_at)>=2000u) {
            uid_at=now; (void)read_uid();
        }
        if (stage>=1u && stage<=3u && g_debug.command) {
            uint32_t opcode=g_debug.command; g_debug.command=0u;
            g_debug.last_opcode=opcode; g_debug.last_status=execute(opcode);
            continue;
        }
        if (stage==3u && g_debug.nfc_present && (uint32_t)(now-poll_at)>=250u) {
            poll_at=now;
            uint8_t a[4],b[4];
            int r=st25_read_command(a);
            if (!r) { board_delay_ms(10u); r=st25_read_command(b); }
            g_debug.nfc_error=r;
            if (!r && memcmp(a,b,4u)==0) {
                bool accepted=command_accept(&tracker,b);
                g_debug.protocol_armed=tracker.baselined;
                if (accepted) {
                    ++g_debug.command_count;
                    g_debug.last_sequence=b[2]; g_debug.last_opcode=b[1];
                    ack_status=execute(b[1]); ack_seq=b[2];
                    g_debug.last_status=ack_status;
                    ack_pending=true; ack_attempts=0u; ack_at=board_millis()-250u;
                }
            }
        }
        now=board_millis();
        if (stage==3u && ack_pending && (uint32_t)(now-ack_at)>=250u) {
            ack_at=now; g_debug.ack_error=st25_write_ack(ack_seq,ack_status);
            if (!g_debug.ack_error || ++ack_attempts>=3u) { ack_pending=false; }
        }
        board_delay_ms(10u);
    }
}
